primitives.name: Branch Synchronization State
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Branches - **Head:** `claude/gse-no-claim-waitlist` - **Base:** `main` (default) - Local HEAD: **13 commits ahead of `origin/main`**, tree clean, fully GREEN (typecheck 0, lint 0, waitlist 49/49, guardrails 6/6).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{local}': 'integer, local commits ahead', 'C_{remote}': 'integer, remote commits behind', 'S_{state}': 'boolean, tree clean status'}
primitives.assumptions: Local repository is authoritative; remote sync is required for full feature PR.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_local ≠ C_remote, synchronization is incomplete.

layer2.mapping: Commit divergence vector maps to PR readiness state in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Commit count difference between local and remote branches.

primitives.name: Pull Request Readiness Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Preview/CI only — do > NOT merge to production without owner sign-off** (merge to `main` triggers a prod > deploy).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_{gate}': 'boolean, automated CI gate status', 'O_{owner}': 'boolean, owner approval status', 'D_{deploy}': 'boolean, deployment trigger status'}
primitives.assumptions: Gate must be GREEN before any production deployment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when G_gate is false or O_owner is false.

layer2.mapping: PR readiness is derived from CI validation and owner sign-off in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Automated CI pass/fail and owner approval flag.

primitives.name: Content No-Claim Compliance Scan
primitives.verbatim_quote: > - **No-claim by construction**, CI-enforced: the compliance scanner runs over the copy, > 50 content drafts, the assembled rendered page, the email drafts, and the research > briefs (0 block flags).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{flags}': 'integer, number of blocked content flags', 'C_{content}': 'set, content units scanned', 'S_{scan}': 'boolean, scan result status'}
primitives.assumptions: All content must pass zero-flag scan for compliance.

layer2.mapping: Compliance scan result maps to GSI claim-free belief state.
layer2.telemetry: Number of flagged content items during CI scan.

These primitives form a dual structure where local state divergence implies incomplete PR readiness, while CI gates and owner sign-offs define the operational boundary for production deployment. Failure modes occur at each layer: divergence mismatch, gate violation, or content flagging. The system operates under a closed-loop feedback mechanism where telemetry from each primitive informs downstream state transitions.
